_note: Window scenes for Visko Orbis. 'prompt' is a full standalone scene (fresh runs and clips). 'morph' is the follow-up prompt used to steer a live stream from the previous stage; null means the change needs reset + the full prompt. Prompt rules: who/what/where + camera, 1-3 sentences, positive wording only, non-violent. Static camera so clips loop and a 15-minute live run does not drift.

scenes.prompt: A small suburban backyard covered in grey cratered dust like the surface of the Moon, with a pale wooden fence and an empty clothesline under a flat white sky. Fine grey powder drifts slowly across the bare ground in a light breeze. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.

A small suburban backyard covered in grey cratered dust like the surface of the Moon, with a pale wooden fence under a flat white sky. In the center, a single patch of purple salvia flowers blooms bright against the grey ground while three honeybees hover over it. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
scenes.morph: A single patch of purple salvia flowers sprouts from the grey dust in the center of the yard and blooms, and three honeybees fly in and hover over it.

scenes.prompt: A small suburban backyard where green grass and white clover spread across grey cratered dust, with patches of purple salvia and blue asters blooming along a pale wooden fence under a soft blue sky. Honeybees fly from flower to flower. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
scenes.morph: Green grass and white clover spread outward across the grey dust, purple salvia and blue asters bloom along the fence, and the sky turns soft blue as more honeybees arrive.

scenes.prompt: A lush suburban backyard in full bloom, with purple salvia, blue asters, white clover and flowering rosemary filling every bed along a sunlit wooden fence under a warm blue sky. Dozens of honeybees and bumblebees drift from flower to flower in golden afternoon light. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
scenes.morph: The whole yard bursts into full bloom with purple salvia, blue asters, white clover and flowering rosemary, golden afternoon sunlight fills the yard, and dozens of bees drift from flower to flower.

scenes.prompt: The blue and white Earth slowly rises above the grey cratered horizon of the Moon into a black sky full of stars, with bright sunlight on the lunar dust in the foreground. Wide shot, low angle, static camera, deep depth of field.
